race.comment: DREAMERS NEVER DIE (1) is racing in good order, missing by 0.8L at this track last time out and now stretches to 1300m. Li's claim is a bonus and he should get every chance from the inside. Best form stacks up and he can land the knockout blow. GIBRALTAR GOLD (7) was sound on resumption, jumping the equal favourite and ending up 0.9L off the winner in a tight finish. Fiore rides now and she should be better with the run under her belt. Watch for her late in the race. PLEASE MIZTER (12) didn't make an impact at his last run before going for a spell on June 21, finishing seventh and beaten 5.5 lengths over 1617m at this track. Has to be respected. STATE OF FURY (8) pushed forward from a wide draw last time and found a forward position then knocked up in the straight to finish ninth over 1300m at Belmont Park. Better than the last run suggests. CHIPILLY (9) can improve stepping up to a more suitable distance today.
